$comment: The deployment compatibility matrix: every (target x rendering mode) cell and what CI does about it.
This file is the source of truth. `tools/deploy-matrix/run.mjs --target <id>` runs a column and fails when a cell does not behave as it says;
`tools/deploy-matrix/report.mjs` joins every column's results and fails on a cell whose evidence is missing;
`tests/library/deploy-matrix.test.js` fails when the table in docs/app/guide/deploy/$page.mdx is not `report.mjs --docs` of this file.
Statuses: verified (the check runs and must pass), rejected (unsupported by design: the build must refuse, naming it),
not-emulated (the target supports it but the emulator cannot show it: the check runs and must fail, so a fixed emulator is noticed),
known-bug (a uf bug with an open issue: the check runs and must fail; `knownBug` on a target means its host cannot start),

targets.title: Deno
targets.runtime: `deno run --allow-net --allow-read --allow-env --allow-write=.uf server.js` (the command `uf build` prints), Deno 2.9.7

targets.title: AWS Lambda
targets.runtime: API Gateway HTTP API in Kumo 0.30.0, function in the AWS Lambda Node 24 image (RIE)

refusal.pattern: prerendered 1 page partially \(/ppr\).*--adapter serverless. buffers every response
regenerates 2 pages \(/isr, /tagged\).*--adapter serverless. has nowhere of its own

targets.title: Static host
targets.runtime: Workers static assets under `wrangler dev --local` (`html_handling: drop-trailing-slash`, `404-page`), no Worker script

refusal.pattern: /ssr/:id \(app/ssr/\[id\]/\$page\.js\) — the build wrote no document for it
/stream/:id \(app/stream/\[id\]/\$page\.js\) — the build wrote no document for it
/ppr \(app/ppr/\$page\.js\) — it reads the request inside a `<Suspense>` boundary
/boom/:id \(app/boom/\[id\]/\$page\.js\) — the build wrote no document for it

notes.kv: Regenerated pages and invalidations are kept in Workers KV (`UF_CACHE`, the binding `uf build --adapter edge` writes), in Wrangler's local KV; the check restarts the Worker and reads them back.
notes.buffered: A Lambda response is one JSON value, so a streaming page arrives whole; the check asserts it is complete and that the fallback and the content arrive together.
notes.ppr-serverless: `uf build --adapter serverless` refuses a page prerendered as a static shell, naming it, because a buffered response would send the shell with its holes.
notes.s3: With a project provider in `rendering.cache.store` (the fixture's `s3-cache.js`, over an S3 bucket in Kumo); the check restarts the function container and reads the page back from S3. Without a provider the build refuses the regenerating pages by name, which is checked too.
notes.kumo-host: Kumo 0.30.0's HTTP API event carries no `host` header and no `requestContext.domainName`, so uf's same-origin check refuses every action (as it should for a request that names no host). Real API Gateway sends both. The check runs and is expected to fail until Kumo does.
notes.kumo-cookies: Kumo 0.30.0 drops the `cookies` array of a payload format 2.0 response, which is where `@uniflowed/server/lambda` puts every `Set-Cookie` (as API Gateway requires). The check runs and is expected to fail until Kumo does.
notes.images: The remote image optimiser needs an image origin the target may fetch and, on `edge`, Cloudflare's Images binding; it is covered in process by `packages/server/image.test.js`, not on these hosts yet.
notes.workers-gzip: Under `wrangler dev`, gzip compression for a client that accepts it holds the static shell until the document ends (shell and hole together at ~1.2 s); with `accept-encoding: identity` the shell arrives at ~4 ms. The Worker streams; the host's compression buffers.
notes.flight-type: Cloudflare's asset server sends a prerendered `__uf.flight` with no content type. The router accepts an untyped `200` for the payload URL whose first line is a Flight row (#1508), so navigation stays on the client; the check asserts that shape. The deploy guide gives the `_headers` rule that types it.
notes.tee-bun-deno: The route-cache fill streams since #1503 under Node; under Bun and Deno the teed branch still reaches the client only when the document ends.
